goal: Produce five independently developed and reviewed proposals, each recommending exactly one diagram and selecting the essay section where it should be added.

output_contract.final_result: Five reviewer-finalized proposals returned to the user; no PDF mutation and no diagram generation.

read: the frozen PDF and its three frozen page renders
for reviewers only, the exact worker output for the same lane
proposed.write: none for agents; the parent materializes exact inline returns into the confirmed output folder
proposed.shell: read-only text extraction and hashing commands only; rendering is not required because page renders are pre-bound
proposed.image_view: allowed for the three pre-rendered PDF pages

capability_profile.enforcement_note: The ACI bridge observes and digest-binds repository inputs and outputs, but it does not prove the provider-side tool sandbox or hidden system inputs. Agents are constrained by the frozen prompt and host tool availability.

runtime.scheduling: capacity-bounded batching of READY groups; lanes remain independent

check_tension_scope: All groups are singleton groups. P5 does not apply; sequential review challenges below are workflow design and are not claimed as formally validated pairwise tension.

lanes.review_method: generative structure-mapping followed by adversarial levels-of-explanation review
lanes.expected_review_challenge: Gentner will favor a legible whole-essay transformation sequence; Marr will reject any sequence that makes emergence look linear, irreversible, or mechanically determined.

worker.angle: structure-mapping methodology: compress the essay's transformations into one relational sequence

reviewer.angle: adversarial levels-of-explanation methodology: test whether the sequence preserves the essay's non-mechanical qualifications

lanes.review_method: formal network modeling followed by adversarial semantic review
lanes.expected_review_challenge: Fong will favor a many-to-many network that exposes composition; Kripke will reject nodes or edge meanings that the prose does not define or that imply a fixed ontology.

worker.angle: formal network methodology: model recoverable relationships without forcing a hierarchy

reviewer.angle: adversarial semantic methodology: test whether every visual entity and relation is textually warranted

lanes.review_method: cognitive compression followed by adversarial bounded-rationality review
lanes.expected_review_challenge: Miller will foreground the cognitively useful contrast between local success and global failure; Gigerenzer will reject an over-clean binary that hides partial knowledge and uncertain context.

worker.angle: cognitive compression methodology: make the local-coherence/global-divergence risk immediately inspectable

reviewer.angle: adversarial bounded-rationality methodology: test whether the contrast suppresses ambiguity or implies omniscient global judgment

lanes.review_method: reconstructive-history modeling followed by adversarial wicked-problem review
lanes.expected_review_challenge: Schacter will favor a visible before/change/after continuity model; Rittel will reject any diagram that presents revision as a closed or cleanly resolved history.

worker.angle: reconstructive-history methodology: show earlier state, revision, reason, and current state as recoverable continuity

reviewer.angle: adversarial wicked-problem methodology: test whether change is falsely shown as complete, settled, or unambiguous

lanes.review_method: system-dynamics modeling followed by adversarial scope review
lanes.expected_review_challenge: Forrester will favor operational paths from ordinary questions through relationships to evidence; Meadows will reject a map that expands the essay into an over-specified product architecture.

worker.angle: system-dynamics methodology: expose traversable paths between objective, work, decisions, conditions, and evidence

reviewer.angle: adversarial scope methodology: test whether the proposal remains an essay explanation rather than an invented system specification
